title: Jehoshaphat's Reforms

questions.question: Who went out to meet King Jehoshaphat when he returned in peace?
options: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer
questions.correctAnswer: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:2 (ESV): "But Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him..."

questions.question: What did Jehu ask Jehoshaphat?
options: Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD?
questions.correctAnswer: Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:2 (ESV): "...Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD?..."

questions.question: Why was wrath upon Jehoshaphat from the LORD?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:2 (ESV): "...Because of this, wrath has gone out against you from the LORD."

questions.question: What good was found in Jehoshaphat?
options: He destroyed the Asheroth and set his heart to seek God
questions.correctAnswer: He destroyed the Asheroth and set his heart to seek God
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:3 (ESV): "Nevertheless, some good is found in you, for you have destroyed the Asheroth... and have set your heart to seek God."

questions.question: What did Jehoshaphat appoint in all the fortified cities?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:5 (ESV): "He appointed judges in the land in all the fortified cities of Judah..."

questions.question: Who did he tell the judges they were judging for?
options: For the LORD, not for man
questions.correctAnswer: For the LORD, not for man
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:6 (ESV): "...Consider what you do, for you judge not for man but for the LORD..."

questions.question: What is NOT with the LORD our God?
options: Injustice or partiality or taking bribes
questions.correctAnswer: Injustice or partiality or taking bribes
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:7 (ESV): "...for there is no injustice with the LORD our God, or partiality or taking bribes."

questions.question: Who did Jehoshaphat appoint in Jerusalem for the judgment of the LORD?
options: Levites, priests, and heads of fathers' houses
questions.correctAnswer: Levites, priests, and heads of fathers' houses
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:8 (ESV): "Moreover, in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed certain Levites and priests and heads of fathers' houses..."

questions.question: How were they commanded to act?
options: In the fear of the LORD, in faithfulness, and with your whole heart
questions.correctAnswer: In the fear of the LORD, in faithfulness, and with your whole heart
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:9 (ESV): "...Thus you shall do in the fear of the LORD, in faithfulness, and with your whole heart."

questions.question: Who was chief priest over them?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:11 (ESV): "And behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD..."

questions.question: Who was the governor of the house of Judah in all the king's matters?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:11 (ESV): "...and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the governor of the house of Judah, in all the king's matters..."

questions.question: Who would serve as officers before them?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:11 (ESV): "...and the Levites will serve you as officers."

questions.question: Why must they warn their brothers?
options: That they may not incur guilt before the LORD and wrath may not come
questions.correctAnswer: That they may not incur guilt before the LORD and wrath may not come
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:10 (ESV): "...you shall warn them that they may not incur guilt before the LORD and wrath may not come upon you..."

questions.question: With whom will the LORD be?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 19:11 (ESV): "...Deal courageously, and may the LORD be with the good!"

key_verse_text: Now then, let the fear of the LORD be upon you. Be careful what you do, for there is no injustice with the LORD our God, or partiality or taking bribes.
